{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Ensure we're only analyzing converted orders
converted_only = real_orders[real_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel and customer_segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = converted_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

# Display the results
print("Average revenue per converted order by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Extract the exact values for each segment and channel
email_loyal = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[0]
email_new = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[1]
email_returning = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email', 'revenue'].iloc[2]

paid_search_loyal = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[0]
paid_search_new = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[1]
paid_search_returning = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.loc[avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search', 'revenue'].iloc[2]

# Compute differences
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

print(f"\nExact values:")
print(f"Email, loyal: {email_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"Paid_search, loyal: {paid_search_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"Email, new: {email_new:.2f}")
print(f"Paid_search, new: {paid_search_new:.2f}")
print(f"Email, returning: {email_returning:.2f}")
print(f"Paid_search, returning: {paid_search_returning:.2f}")
print(f"\nDifferences (email - paid_search):")
print(f"Loyal: {diff_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"New: {diff_new:.2f}")
print(f"Returning: {diff_returning:.2f}")"}
